newsitem.title: UK: Labour's Brown promises "sensible" minimum wage.
newsitem.headline: Labour's Brown promises "sensible" minimum wage.

text.p: - Gordon Brown, financial affairs spokesman for Britain's opposition Labour party, on Monday promised that a future Labour government would introduce a minimum wage at a "sensible" level.
In a speech to the Confederation of British Industry, the shadow chancellor said a Labour government would not "introduce legilsation which will damage the interests of Britain."
Therefore, he said, "we have made clear that we will only set a figure after consultation with business, including small firms, and after taking account of the economic situation at the time."
Labour has carefully avoided setting a target for a minimum wage, and has resisted trade union demands for a minimum wage of 4.62 stg an hour.
